wec8p2sg.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 125 cm
wec8p2sg.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 125 cm
wec8p2sg.sourceDescription: This Modern Metal Christmas tree exemplifies contemporary elegance, combining the simplicity of minimalist design with the charm of holiday cheer. Styled in a gleaming gold hue and a matte finish, it presents a tasteful blend of style and simplicity suited for any modern home setting. Its sleek form and contour make it an ideal centerpiece for living rooms or hallways, blending seamlessly into any seasonal decor scheme. Tailored for the modern holiday enthusiast, it projects a festive yet understated aura that is both captivating and inviting. Materials: Made from powder-coated steel, this Metal Christmas tree stands out with its robust, abrasion-resistant qualities. The selection of material not only contributes to a sleek modern look but ensures durability and lasting use through several festive seasons. Included Components: The tree features an integrated sturdy steel stand, providing reliable stability to keep it firmly upright. This component minimizes the need for additional supports, making setup straightforward and quick. Features /Function /Design: The tree embodies modern design, offering clean lines and minimal ornamentation. Its gold matte finish enhances its visual appeal, giving a chic touch to traditional Christmas decor while maintaining a functional and practical setup. Recommended Uses: This tree is perfect for both living room and hallway spaces. Its refined elegance easily transforms any indoor or sheltered outdoor area into a festive environment, allowing you to celebrate in style, whether you're entertaining guests or enjoying a quiet holiday. Care &Maintenance: Assemble the tree according to the manufacturer's instructions. Once the festive season is over, disassemble and store it carefully to preserve its condition for future use. Product Specifications Colour: Gold Material: Powder-coated steel Tree height: 125 cm Stand size: 47 x 20 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Metal Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

q2hexkzr.baseName: My Christmas 7ft Snow Flocked Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with LED Lights
q2hexkzr.variantName: My Christmas 7ft Snow Flocked Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with LED Lights
q2hexkzr.sourceDescription: Create a festive winter display with this 7ft artificial Christmas tree, featuring 1,268 lifelike PE and PVC tips with snow-flocked accents for a snowy appearance. Its sturdy branches provide support for your favourite Christmas ornaments, while the hinged construction allows the branches to open easily for shaping and fluffing. The tree is pre-lit with dual-colour LED lights, allowing you to switch between warm white and cool white illumination using the included remote control. Choose from 9 lighting effects to create your preferred festive atmosphere. A robust metal stand provides reliable support, and the tree can be disassembled into four parts for convenient storage after the festive season. Ideal for decorating homes, offices and shopping spaces. Specifications: Made from a PE and PVC blend with 1,268 branch tips and snow-flocked accents. Features dual-colour LED lights with warm white and cool white settings, 9 lighting effects and an included remote control. Hinged branches allow easy assembly and shaping. Supplied with a sturdy metal stand and designed for repeated seasonal use. Dimensions: Height 7ft (approximately 213cm). Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
